verdict.rationale: Lithic's Auth Stream Access (ASA) is documented as an HTTP POST-based real-time endpoint that must respond with an approval/decline decision during authorization [lithic-docs-2], directly matching the core of this story. However, the evidence pack does not document the specific time budget (latency window) or a configurable timeout fallback policy the developer controls, which the story explicitly requires. Missing for 10: documented response-time budget/SLA, explicit timeout fallback configuration options, and independent/hands-on confirmation of real-time behavior.
